"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Cable companies and telecoms vie over enclosing and monopolizing the Internet’s open-access structure.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"News content is homogenized.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Debate parameters are squeezed to the point where the media begins to take on the characteristics of a consciousness-molding, status-quo-affirming industry.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Thirty years of corporate marauding leaves the U.S. today politically despised abroad and economically unstable at home.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"For prosperity to be sustainable in the long run, government policy must promote democratic urban planning.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"For prosperity to be sustainable in the long run, government policy must promote environmentally conscious forms of consumption and production.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"For prosperity to be sustainable in the long run, government policy must promote far greater public oversight of corporate behavior.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"For prosperity to be sustainable in the long run, government policy must promote global rules that promote sustainability and economic development.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
